in_sanskrit.name: Nakka
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nakka एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nakha’, meaning ‘claw’ or ‘tooth’. In Hindu mythology, Nakka refers to the demon king Nalasena, who was vanquished by Lord Hanuman. This name symbolizes courage and victory.
